name: fleet
description: Control plane: plan a task into a slice DAG, gate it, then spawn a fresh orchestrator per slice (parallel where independent, sequenced where dependent) with worktree isolation, auto-merge of clean slices, and rule/skill knowledge transfer across slices. Run /grill-me first to disambiguate.

task.description: The work to fleet out (or use planPath).

planPath.description: Path to a disambiguated spec doc (from /grill-me).

baseBranch.description: Branch to integrate into; integration branch is cut fresh from origin/<baseBranch>.
